prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create the corrected TRANSFORMED NERAL dialogue bust, a monstrous mutated Ignoto alchemist, for the Coreto/Terminus game.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the author's PRIMARY ANATOMY reference. Specifically use the TWO ENORMOUS BRUTES at LEFT and RIGHT, NOT the slender middle wizard. Image 2 is Neral before transformation: use for his costume identity, pale pupil-less eyes, and exact sepia pen-and-ink rendering style. His face and body now undergo a major monstrous mutation.
ANATOMY: Match the hulking proportions and bestial facial anatomy of the outer creatures in Image 1. Massive barrel torso, extremely broad heavy shoulders, enormous sloping trapezius and thick neck merging into a hunched back, relatively small bald head thrust forward and low between the shoulders. Huge heavy arms, oversized clawed hands. Pale ivory-white living skin, completely hairless. Small pointed ears, deep dark angular eye sockets with Neral's pale ivory eyes, reduced flattened nose, broad distorted jaw and very wide snarling mouth packed with sharp irregular teeth as in the right brute. Make this a convincing member of that same monstrous species. Prioritize the anatomy of image 1 over the unchanged human facial proportions in image 2. Two arms, two hands, one head.
COSTUME CONTINUITY: Neral's brown alchemist coat has burst open across chest and shoulders under this enormous growth. Expose most of the huge chest and arms. Retain torn sections of the distinctive pale angular piping, a few recognizable diamond fasteners on hanging fabric and his belt. His hood hangs collapsed/torn behind the neck; bald head and bestial face fully visible. Do not transfer the reference brutes' scythes, weapons, spiked armor, fur or emblem. No extra equipment.
POSE/COMPOSITION: One single large head-to-waist bust in three-quarter view, leaning forward menacingly; massive shoulders and forearms dominate the silhouette, both clawed hands visible near waist, enough canvas width and transparent margin to avoid clipping them. The size of the hands and shoulders relative to head must communicate a gigantic brute. No other characters, no full-body sheet, no comparison panel.
STYLE: Match Image 2's Coreto style: crisp bold black ink contours, intricate fine stippling and crosshatching, warm parchment-ivory flesh and muted sepia/ochre-brown clothing. Stylized dark fantasy illustration, not photorealistic or 3D. Strong readable silhouette. Genuine transparent background, no ground shadow, no white rectangle.
Avoid hair, eyebrows, beard, horns, wings, extra limbs, tentacles, magic aura, symbols, text, gore, wounds or blood. The teeth and claws are allowed and essential.
correcao: Anatomia e rosto bestiais baseados nos dois Ignotos grandes da referência fornecida pelo autor. Olhos claros e fragmentos do traje preservam continuidade com Neral.

aprovacao_usuario.texto: Agora sim, ficou ótimo. Atualize a spritesheet do Neral transformado para seguir esse concept.
aprovacao_usuario.escopo: concept/busto transformado v4; autoriza adaptação da spritesheet
